title: SkinReportGenerated v1
description: Analysis completed. Subscribed to by Skin Profile (trend), Recommendations (tips), and Notifications (the push that covers a backgrounded app, PD-4).

overallScore.description: Higher is better. Already rescaled from the vendor range.

skinAge.description: Null on tiers with no skin-age reading. Null is a real value here, not a missing one.

issues.description: All six, always. An unmeasured concern appears with severity 'unknown' rather than being omitted — otherwise a consumer cannot distinguish 'we looked and found nothing' from 'we never looked'.

rulesetVersion.description: Which SeverityRuleSet produced these severities (PD-2). On the event, not just the read model, so the compliance audit trail can reconstruct why a referral fired without joining back to mutable state.
